answers.question: How much is the Growth plan, and how much do I save paying yearly?
answers.reply: The Growth plan is $49/month, or $490/year if you pay annually. Paying yearly saves approximately 17% compared to monthly billing, which works out to two months free. On Growth, that means $490 instead of $588 for twelve months of monthly payments.

answers.question: If I pay annually and cancel after two weeks, do I get money back?
answers.reply: Yes, you can. Annual subscriptions can be refunded on a prorated basis if you cancel within the first 30 days of the annual term, so cancelling after two weeks qualifies. You can cancel from Billing Settings > Subscription > Cancel Plan. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period, and the knowledge base doesn't say exactly how the refund is requested or calculated, so I can pass that to the team if you'd like.

answers.question: Can I connect Orbitly to n8n?
answers.reply: Orbitly doesn't have an official n8n connector at this time. You can still connect it using Orbitly's generic REST API through n8n's HTTP or webhook modules. Note that the REST API requires the Scale plan.
